title: Strict scalar-extension diagram of the fixed open total tensor source
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $R$ a commutative ring sheaf, $V\in\mathcal C$, and assume module sheafification and locally-bijective compatibility on the base site in a containing universe. Fix arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes $Q$ on the slice and $F$ on the base, and write $M=\operatorname{Tot}(j_!Q\otimes_R F)$ using [def-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-data]. The complexes $\operatorname{Res}_{R\to A}(M\otimes_R A)$, indexed by all unital $R$-algebra sheaves $A$ and their unital maps, admit a StrictFamily as defined in [def-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-normalization]. For every algebra map $h:A\to B$, degrees $p+q=n$, $f:W\to V$, $x\in Q^p(W,f)$, $y\in F^q(W)$ and $a\in A(W)$, its map sends the actual sourceSection $([x]_f\otimes y)\otimes a$ to $([x]_f\otimes y)\otimes h(a)$. Its identity and composition laws are strict chain-map equalities. No target projection comparison is involved.

proof.text: The algebraModules functor sends a coefficient algebra to its underlying $R$-module and an algebra map to its section maps. Compose it with the flipped curried tensor functor. Apply the resulting functors and natural transformations termwise to the fixed complex $M$. This gives a strict diagram of the complexes $M\otimes_R A$, with identity and composition from functoriality of mapHomologicalComplex.

proof.text: The normalized tensor-to-scalar-extension isomorphism, natural in the module argument, commutes with the differential and gives a complex isomorphism at each coefficient algebra. Conjugate the previous diagram maps by these isomorphisms. Cancellation gives their strict identity and composition laws. Its normalized formula takes $z\otimes a$ to the actual scalar-extension generator. The tensor map sends this to $z\otimes h(a)$; transporting back gives the required formula, specialized to the homogeneous section $z=[x]_f\otimes y$.

theorem sourceCoefficientFamily_exists
    (Q : Complex.{max c v, v, r} (R.over V)) (F : Complex.{c, v, r} R) :
    ∃ D : StrictFamily.{c, v, r} R (fun A ↦ source.{c, v, r} R V A Q F),
      ∀ {A B : Under R} (a : A ⟶ B)
        (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (W : C) (f : W ⟶ V)
        (x : (Q.X p).val.obj (op (Over.mk f))) (y : (F.X q).val.obj (op W))
        (s : A.right.obj.obj (op W)),
        (((D.map a).f n).val.app (op W))
            (sourceSection.{c, v, r} R V A Q F p q n h W f x y s) =
          sourceSection.{c, v, r} R V B Q F p q n h W f x y
            (a.right.hom.app (op W) s)
